children.name: herb.moonbloom.desc
children.text: Opens under warm lamplight and lifts whoever stands on its bed. Two come with the Conservatory; more are 2 fireflies in the Garden shop.

children.name: herb.duskcap.desc
children.text: Rises tall in shadow and shrinks from fire. Sold in the Garden shop once 6 rooms are tended.

children.name: herb.firefly.desc
children.text: Drawn to quiet side paths. Every one caught puts 3 in your jar to spend in the Garden shop.

children.name: herb.gracelily.desc
children.text: A rare pale bloom named for Elizabeth Grace. Sold in the Garden shop once you hold 10 Master Gardener Par medals.

children.name: herb.traversrose.desc
children.text: An heirloom specimen of the Travers Conservatory. Sold in the Garden shop when every room is tended.

children.name: herb.journal.desc
children.text: Every lamp lit in the quiet dark is a small kindness kept for the morning. Tend the garden at your own pace.

children.name: ach.ach_first.desc
children.text: Tend your very first garden room.

children.name: ach.ach_ch2.desc
children.text: Tend 6 rooms and enter The Shade Walk.

children.name: ach.ach_builder.desc
children.text: Place 8 pieces in The Travers Conservatory.

children.name: ach.ach_grand.desc
children.text: Grow the Conservatory to its largest size (14 × 8).

children.name: Subtitle
children.text: {ng_jar} fireflies in your jar · {hub_placed} of {hub_cap} pieces placed

children.name: Hint
children.text: Every room tended gives 1 ✦, every firefly caught 3, every par medal 2 · Esc back

children.name: how.walk.words
children.text: The arrow keys or W A S D walk one bed at a time, along the paths. Hold Shift to turn on the spot.

children.name: how.lamp.words
children.text: E lights or douses the lamp beside you. A gold mark shows which one.

children.name: how.moonbloom.words
children.text: A moonbloom rises while its bed is lit and sinks in the dark. Stand on one to ride it.

children.name: how.duskcap.words
children.text: A duskcap rises in the dark and sinks in light.

children.name: how.crate.words
children.text: Walk into a crate to push it. A risen bloom or a tall screen casts a shadow.

children.name: how.exit.words
children.text: The green ring is the way out. R starts the room again. Fireflies are for the curious.

children.name: Hint
children.text: W / S choose · A / D change · Esc back

children.name: Hint
children.text: E change the chosen control, then press the new key · Esc back

children.name: end.line
children.text: Every bed is tended and every lamp has had its turn. Thank you for walking the garden.

children.name: end.dedication
children.text: For Elizabeth Grace — who brings every garden to life.
